name: Subtitle Manager
description: Finds sidecar subtitles (.srt/.ass/.ssa/.vtt, Subs/ folders) and embedded text tracks, and converts them on the fly to WebVTT for browser playback. Can pre-extract embedded subtitles after each library scan.
author: Streamora

settings.label: Subtitle sub-folders
settings.description: Folder names next to the video that are searched for subtitle files.

settings.label: Languages to pre-extract
settings.description: ISO 639 codes or names (en, eng, English). Empty = every language.

settings.label: Pre-extract embedded subtitles after scans
settings.description: Extracting from large MKV files can take a while; doing it ahead of time makes subtitles appear instantly.
